description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Public Sector Counsel to lead legal support for Horizon3's growing public sector business. This role will be the primary legal partner to our Public Sector Sales, Capture/RFP, and Compliance teams, with responsibility for navigating the unique contractual, regulatory, and procurement requirements that apply to federal, state, and local government customers and their integrator/prime ecosystems.

You will drive strategy and execution on government RFPs/RFIs, negotiate and manage complex public sector agreements (direct and through partners), and help design scalable processes that allow us to grow our public sector revenue while maintaining strong compliance and an efficient, business-enabling posture. This is a senior, hands-on role in a lean legal team with significant visibility to GTM and executive leadership.

What You’ll Do

Public Sector Transactions & RFP Support

  • Lead legal review and negotiation of federal, SLED, and other public sector contracts, including:

    • Government cloud/SaaS agreements, enterprise license agreements, and task orders.

    • Partner/reseller, systems integrator, and OEM/teaming agreements for public sector routes to market.

    • DPAs, information security addenda, and federal / SLED data handling terms relevant to cybersecurity SaaS.

  • Own legal support for end-to-end RFP/RFI and bid processes, including:

    • Reviewing and advising on solicitation terms, instructions, and evaluation criteria.

    • Identifying and escalating materially risky or non-standard clauses (e.g., unlimited liability, broad audit, IP ownership, most-favored-customer, termination, and data localization requirements).

    • Drafting and negotiating exceptions, alternate language, and clarifying questions.

  • Partner closely with Public Sector Sales, Capture/Proposal, and Finance to structure commercially viable, compliant deals that map to our SaaS model and pricing.

Regulatory, Compliance, and Procurement Frameworks

  • Advise on the application of U.S. federal procurement and compliance regimes to Horizon3.ai’s offerings (e.g., FAR/DFARS flowdowns as applicable, government rights in data, information security and privacy mandates, incident reporting, records retention, and audit rights).

  • Coordinate with Security, Compliance, and Revenue Operations on the legal aspects of:

    • FedRAMP, StateRAMP, and similar frameworks as they become relevant to our roadmap.

    • Public sector–specific security requirements (e.g., agency security addenda, data residency, background checks, and facility/access provisions) and how they interact with our standard SaaS architecture and policies.

  • Support development of standard playbooks for recurring public sector issues, including government IP/data rights, open records / FOIA risk, export control, sanctions, and data sovereignty questions.

Templates, Playbooks, and Process Scaling

  • Develop and maintain public sector–specific templates and negotiation playbooks, including:

    • Government-focused order forms, addenda, security and data terms, and partner/subcontractor language.

    • Standard positions and fallback language on high-risk terms (e.g., audit, unlimited indemnities, security mandates, most-favored pricing).

  • Design and improve public sector contract and RFP workflows in partnership with Legal Ops and Deals Desk to:

    • Ensure timely support for high-volume, time-sensitive RFPs/RFIs.

    • Standardize issue spotting and escalation paths for Sales and Capture teams.

  • Create and deliver training for Sales, Capture, and other stakeholders on public sector contracting basics, risk flags, and how to engage Legal early and effectively.

Cross-Functional & Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as the primary legal point of contact for Public Sector GTM leadership, providing pragmatic, business-focused advice on deal strategy, contract risk, and long-term account planning.

  • Partner with Product, Security, and Compliance on new public sector initiatives, such as:

    • Adaptations of NodeZero for specific government environments or procurement vehicles.

    • Data usage, telemetry, and AI/ML-related questions specific to government customers.

  • Contribute to broader Horizon3.ai legal initiatives as needed, including commercial, channel, and privacy/cybersecurity topics that intersect with public sector work.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • J.D. (or equivalent) from an accredited law school; admitted to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • 7+ years of relevant legal experience, with a substantial portion focused on U.S. public sector / government contracting (e.g., federal and/or SLED) at a law firm and/or in-house at a technology/SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Demonstrated experience:

    • Reviewing and negotiating government contracts, RFP/RFI terms, and related flowdowns.

    • Handling government-facing SaaS or cloud transactions, including data security, privacy, and compliance terms.

    • Supporting complex, high-value deals with cross-functional revenue teams.

  • Strong working knowledge of key public sector concepts, including FAR/DFARS principles, government data and IP rights, audit and inspection rights, information security mandates, and common federal/SLED procurement models (e.g., primes, resellers, GWACs/IDIQs, coops).

  • Excellent contract drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to non-lawyers and drive to balanced, risk-aware solutions under time pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cybersecurity and/or offensive security products or services, particularly SaaS platforms.

  • Familiarity with or exposure to FedRAMP/StateRAMP, CJIS, CMMC, or similar regulatory and security frameworks.

  • Top secret security clearance

  • Prior in-house role supporting a public sector sales or capture function (federal, defense, SLED).

  • Comfort working with AI tools and legal operations technology to streamline contract review and RFP support.

  • A practical, business-minded approach to risk—able to distinguish between “must-have” compliance requirements and negotiable preferences.

Why Join Horizon3 Legal

  • Directly shape how a fast-growing cybersecurity company enters and scales in the public sector.

  • Partner with experienced GTM, security, and product leaders on mission-critical government work.

  • Join a lean, high-impact legal team where your work is visible, valued, and central to company strategy.

  • Fully remote role with competitive compensation, equity, and benefits, plus meaningful opportunities for career growth and leadership as our public sector business expands.

If you’re a public sector–savvy lawyer who enjoys complex, high-stakes deals and building scalable processes from the ground up, we’d love to talk.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $162,945 - $213,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
